liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Blow Away** (1 review): Performance displayed fantastic energy, typical of the song [12]
- **Other One** (1 review): Intense performance with ascending chromatic chords, requiring caution advisories [15]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Exceptional performance featuring a smoking middle jam [21]

## Setlist highlights

- **audience in**: rare: 4 archived performances [24]
- **LTGTR**: rare: 6 archived performances [24]
- **BIODTL**: back after 222 archived shows (976 days) [24]
- **Ramble On**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **audience in**: rare: 4 archived performances [24]
- **Help**: rare: 6 archived performances [24]
- **Franklin's**: rare: 8 archived performances [24]
- **L. L. Rain**: back after 352 archived shows (1716 days); rare: 7 archived performances [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-12-08.fob.french.35372.sbeok.flac24** (recommended): source not stated; 22 songs; 165 min [1]
- **gd1989-12-08.fob.french.76251.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 165 min [2]
- **gd1989-12-08.140265.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 163 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1989-12-08.sbd.walker-scotton-miller.88398.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 160 min; rated 3.64/5 by 11 [5]. Said about its sound: Tight, solid playing with energy and very nice sound quality [19]
- **gd89-12-08.aud.wiley.8961.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 163 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [8]. Said about its sound: Clear sound with minimal talker pickup in audience recording [13]

## Around the show

- Listener was removed for videotaping, missing the encore [12]
- Shows occurred at the Forum during Lakers Showtime era [14]
- Listener remembers the show as mind blowing [16]
- Trippy atmosphere with a balloon guy present at the venue [20]
- First West Coast Help/Slip/Frank sequence was considered great [12]
- Forum shows were solid and fun, with tight late 80s playing [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-12-08.fob.french.35372.sbeok.flac24**: taped by Mike French; transferred by Mike French and Scott Brown; source: Sennheiser MKE2002 omni's HRTF stealth stereo -> Sony TC-D5M [1]. Also: Bob Loy reencoded Mike French's fileset to flac level 8 [1]
- **gd1989-12-08.fob.french.76251.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Mike French; transferred by Bob Loy; source: Sennheiser MKE2002 omni's HRTF stealth stereo -> Sony TC-D5M [2]. Also: Bob Loy converted to 16/44.1, patching crowd noise and crossfades [2]
- **gd1989-12-08.140265.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Ultra Matrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) [3]. Also: File set is 16 bit, listing specific setlist order [3]
- **gd1989-12-08.sbd.walker-scotton-miller.88398.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) D [5]. Also: Remastered by Charlie, noted as a Miller remaster; Tapes from Paul Scotton and Joani Walker, with pitch correction [5][17]
- **gd89-12-08.aud.wiley.8961.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD>DAT>CDR [8]
